utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday 30 July. Can you hear me all right? Teams is doing that spinning thing again.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, you're through. Anyone see the football last night?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Unfortunately. There's ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oh, come on, last ten minutes were decent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, pundits off. We're all here, are we?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm here. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid, so I've only just sat down.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same. Think I spent longer looking at the gate than driving the rest of it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And then the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Lovely start. That's a moan, by the way, not me volunteering to fix it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cold tea's available if you fancy a different disappointment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Living the dream. Let's get the finished bits out of the way first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the Boiler Safety Relief Valve yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the one that was still showing open on the list?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, that one. Finished yesterday, nothing new off the back of it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the number two bearing on Tuesday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Both closed, not rolling them into today's jobs.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: tested the AC1 yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, cheers. I wasn't sure whether that was an old entry.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It was. Separate thing, I heard a slight rattle from the 11kV Switchboard, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just an observation at this point, then? Not a job you're asking anyone to take?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the compressor one. That's still blocked, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, still sitting as blocked in the schedule. No confirmed delivery to plan around.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're on blocked things, can't get to the Palletiser until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's not being handed out as a fresh job this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No. Just explaining why it hasn't moved.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Marc, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the Injection Moulding Line 2 this morning? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Injection Moulding Line 2 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. This morning was the permit and isolation, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, that whole bit this morning. Fairly important, so not one to leave in the odds-and-ends pile.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got you. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, the other one for you: can you sort the training records for the new starters, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort the training records for the new starters. Whenever I get a chance, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No fixed deadline on the records, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No fixed deadline. That's the whenever-you-get-a-chance one, not the same urgency as the permit.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Fine, yeah. Two separate things, I've got them.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, could you book a contractor to look at the fire alarm panel?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep—sorry, just making sure: you're asking me to make the booking, not saying the contractor has to be here this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, book a contractor to look at it. I'm not putting a visit deadline on that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, I'll book a contractor to look at the fire alarm panel.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not the coffee machine contractor, before anyone gets their hopes up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Definitely not. My coffee complaint remains strictly a complaint.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll order spare parts for the CT1 next week. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah against the CT1 spare parts, next week, no rush. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Next week, not an urgent order.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, good. Not another thing in this morning's scramble.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round on the 3rd. That's very much in the 'if you've got a spare minute' category, not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Saz for the shift handover report, on the 3rd, low priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, exactly. I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, there is still the near miss at the line 2 robot to write up, on the 3rd. It needs doing, but I'm raising the gap here, not taking the write-up.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I haven't taken that one either.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor me. Don't put it against me just because I've come off mute.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that's genuinely no owner at the moment?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Write up the near miss at the line 2 robot, on the 3rd, but unallocated. Nobody's agreed to take it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks. Just didn't want it looking like an HSE commitment because I'd mentioned it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quick check before we go: Marc, permit and isolation this morning, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, agreed. And the new starters' training records whenever I get a chance. Haven't mixed those up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I've got the contractor booking for the fire alarm panel.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Near miss still has a blank owner, though. That's the outstanding gap, not silently sitting with anyone.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly, yes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks all. That's the stand-up. I'll let you get on.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. Back to arguing about the football, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Without coffee? You're on your own, mate.
